Fixed: classify_file() in scripts/rank_players.py now classifies data/*.xlsx by BOTH schema sniff (Pos column => skater, W/GA/SV/SO with no Pos => goalie) and filename pattern (fallback when unreadable), with a hard SystemExit error for files matching neither shape. resolve_input_files() now returns skater-only files; resolve_goalie_files() routes goalie-shaped files automatically. Verified against the real 5-file data/ dir: skater order is now [2025-2026, 2024-2025, 2023-2024], goalie files excluded and resolved separately. Regression tests added in tests/test_goalie_multiseason.py (10 of 14 new tests fail against pre-fix code).

Fixed: --goalie-input on rank_players.py is now repeatable (argparse action=append), and goalie exports are auto-discovered from data/ via the yahoo_fantasy_bot-soj classifier when --goalie-input is omitted. Added scoring.combine_goalie_files() to decay-weight-blend W/GA/SV/SO/GP across multiple goalie season files (same decay scheme as skaters), fed into the existing goalie_stats_df merge path in score_dataframe/score_multiple_files. Also fixed a related bug this surfaced: score_dataframe now pairs the matched real raw_score with the goalie-stats export's OWN GP (not a mismatched single-skater-season GP), avoiding a per_game blow-up when blending across seasons. Verified end-to-end against real data/ (2024-2025 + 2025-2026 goalie files): both seasons visibly contribute to combined scores. Regression tests in tests/test_goalie_multiseason.py, including a pinned Hellebuyck sanity check (5*47-3*125+0.6*1539+5*8=823.4) and explicit SOG-alias-collision tests.

Backfilled Name/Team/Pos for goalies missing from the newest (or every) skater file, using the goalie export as source of truth; added goalie_gp/goalie_raw_score columns; fixed a latent weight-override bug (goalie flat-weight override applied even to file indices where the goalie had no row at all) that the Pos backfill would otherwise have exposed.
